Reliable Circuit Design for Steady Power
The +5V & 3.3V DC to DC circuit design enhances efficiency and stabilizes output voltage for consistent system performance.
230V EU Standard certification for lower power loss, less heat, and quieter operation.
Engineered for power-hungry graphics cards, this design delivers robust power to handle even the most demanding overloading conditions, ensuring peak performance in every gaming session.
Engineered with a proven circuit design and high-quality electrolytic capacitors to ensure sustained stability and long-term operation under high workloads.
Built with optimized thermal solution and an advanced 120mm HDB fan for cooler components and quieter operation.
140mm in length which is relatively shorter than industry standard, it’s ideal for compact PC or space-constraint environment without compromising on performance.
Thermal Resilience: Power You Can Depend On.

The VIC WD power supply is engineered for reliable power delivery, even in temperatures up to 40°C. Count on stable performance for your everyday computing, ensuring system longevity without heat concerns.
*Performance data based on testing conducted at 25°C ambient temperature.
Featuring improved black, embossed cables that are soft and easy to bend, users can manage them more easily, saving time and creating more space for optimal cooling performance in your PC build.
Strong Power Supply for CPU Needs
This power supply is equipped with dual 4+4-pin PCIe power connectors, delivering ample 12V power to meet the demands of high-performance CPUs.
Our comprehensive circuit shields your valuable components from harm.
